welcome.title: Welcome to ChatVia.ai
welcome.description: A short tour shows you around the dashboard and helps you set up your first agent.
welcome.how_move: Use Next and Back, or the arrow keys, to move between steps.
welcome.how_skip: Close a step or press Esc to stop the tour at any time.
welcome.how_again: Start it again any time with Take the tour in your menu.

dashboard.agents_text: Every agent you build is listed here. Open one to change it, teach it or read its chats.
dashboard.inbox_text: Chats that need a person show up here, so your team can take over from the agent.
dashboard.ask_text: Ask questions about your chats, agents and leads in plain words.
dashboard.teams_text: Switch between your teams here, or create a new one.
dashboard.notifications_text: The bell tells you when something needs you, such as a chat waiting for a person.
dashboard.menu_text: Your account, your workspace settings and the language. You can take this tour again from here.
dashboard.create_text: Give it a name and we will show you how to set it up.

agent.sections_text: Each section changes one part of your agent: its instructions, model, languages, look and more.
agent.surfaces_text: Your agent can answer on a hosted chat page, in a chat widget on your site and in a command bar. Each one has its own look and behavior.
agent.preview_text: The preview shows your agent with its saved settings. Chat with it here to test it.
agent.knowledge_text: Add files, websites, text or questions and answers. Your agent answers from them.
agent.playground_text: Chat with your agent in the Playground before you share it.
agent.deploy_text: When it is ready, add it to your website or share a link to its chat page from Deploy.
